texts.Feature:AddressLookup.Description: Fills the city, the street and the coordinates of an address from its postal code and house number through an external address source (PDOK for the Netherlands, OpenStreetMap elsewhere).
texts.OpenTms.Integrations:RoutingUnavailable: The routing service is unavailable; the calculation is retried automatically.
texts.HealthCheck:pdfgeneratorapi:Impact: No document can be generated or printed: CMR, invoices, reports and every other document template.
texts.HealthCheck:pdfgeneratorapi:NotConfigure: The key and secret of the pdfgeneratorapi account are missing. Enter them in Administration → Services → Documents (or set Integrations:PdfGeneratorApi:Key and Secret in the deployment).
texts.HealthCheck:pdfgeneratorapi:Unreachable: pdfgeneratorapi ({target}) cannot be reached. Check the network and pdfgeneratorapi's status page.
texts.HealthCheck:pdfgeneratorapi:Failing: pdfgeneratorapi refuses the request: usually a wrong key or secret, or a missing workspace. Check them in Administration → Services → Documents; the error names the cause.
texts.HealthCheck:routing:Impact: No road distances or driving times: whatever needs them falls back to straight-line estimates (CO₂: the great-circle estimate).
texts.HealthCheck:routing:NotConfigured: The routing provider {provider} has no address. Enter it in Administration → Services → Routing (or set Integrations:Routing in the deployment).
texts.HealthCheck:routing:Unreachable: {provider} ({target}) does not answer. Check that the routing server runs and that the API can reach it; the address is in Administration → Services → Routing.
texts.HealthCheck:route-function:Impact: CO₂ per leg uses the great-circle estimate instead of the road route.
texts.HealthCheck:route-function:NotConfigured: Not configured: CO₂ uses the great-circle estimate. Enter the route function's address in Administration → Services → Routing to use road routes.
texts.HealthCheck:route-function:Unreachable: The route function ({target}) does not answer; CO₂ uses the great-circle estimate meanwhile.
texts.HealthCheck:route-optimizer:Impact: Suggested stop orders come from the built-in heuristic instead of VROOM.
texts.HealthCheck:route-optimizer:NotConfigure: Not configured: the built-in heuristic orders the stops. Enter the VROOM address in Administration → Services → Routing to use VROOM.
texts.HealthCheck:route-optimizer:Unreachable: VROOM ({target}) does not answer; the heuristic orders the stops meanwhile.
texts.HealthCheck:postmark:Impact: No e-mail can be sent: invitations, password resets and every other message.
texts.HealthCheck:postmark:Ok: Postmark answers for the configured server.
texts.HealthCheck:postmark:NotConfigured: The server token or the sender is missing. Enter them in Administration → Services → E-mail, or set Integrations:Postmark:ServerToken and FromAddress.
texts.HealthCheck:postmark:Unreachable: Postmark cannot be reached. Check the network and Postmark's status page.
texts.HealthCheck:postmark:Failing: Postmark refuses the server token (HTTP {status}). Check the token in Administration → Services → E-mail.
texts.Services:Notice: Applies to every tenant. A save applies at once on this instance and within a minute on the others. An empty field uses the deployment's configuration, shown under the field.
texts.Services:Section.Documents.Description: Generates every document from its template: CMR, invoices, reports. One account for every tenant.
texts.Services:Section.Routing.Description: Road distances, driving times and routes; the route function also calculates CO₂, VROOM suggests the stop order.
texts.Services:Secret.Stored: A value is stored; leave empty to keep it.
texts.Services:Secret.FromConfiguration: Nothing stored: the deployment's value applies.
texts.Services:Secret.None: Nothing stored, and the deployment has no value.
texts.Services:Url.Invalid: Enter a full address, starting with http:// or https://.
texts.Services:TestUnsaved: Save first: the test uses the saved settings.
texts.Services:InvalidRoutingProvider: Choose OSRM or Route function as the routing provider.
texts.Permission:ImportProfiles.Manage: Activate, retire and delete import profiles
texts.Permission:IntakeApi.Submit: Submit orders through the intake API
texts.Feature:OrderIntake.Description: Connected mailboxes are read, the intake API answers and received documents become transport orders.
texts.Feature:OrderIntake.AiMapping.Descriptio: Documents no import profile can read are sent to the language model (Anthropic) to learn their layout. Their content and the names of order types, waypoint types and transport units leave OpenTMS; relation and address data never do.
texts.Integrations:Setting.ProfileActivationTh: Confirmations before an import profile is trusted
After this many orders confirmed without a correction (1 to 20), a proposed import profile becomes active and may lead to automatically confirmed orders.
texts.OpenTms.Integrations:MailboxStateInvalid: This is not possible for a mailbox that is {status}.
texts.OpenTms.Integrations:MailboxAlreadyConne: This mailbox and folder are connected already ({emailAddress}).
texts.OpenTms.Integrations:MailboxAccountMisma: Sign in with the account of this connection ({emailAddress}).
texts.OpenTms.Integrations:OAuthStateInvalid: The sign-in at the mail provider has expired or is not valid. Start connecting again.
texts.OpenTms.Integrations:ProviderNotConfigur: {provider} is not set up yet. The administrator enters it in Administration → Services → Integrations.
texts.OpenTms.Integrations:DocumentTooLarge: The file is too large; at most {maxBytes} bytes are accepted.
texts.OpenTms.Integrations:UnsupportedFormat: This file type cannot be read ({contentType}).
texts.OpenTms.Integrations:ImportProfileStateI: This is not possible for an import profile that is {status}.
texts.OpenTms.Integrations:AiMappingDisabled: AI mapping is off for this tenant.
texts.OpenTms.Integrations:AiMappingFailed: The language model could not read the document; it needs attention.
texts.Mailboxes:FolderNotFound: This folder no longer exists in the mailbox. Choose another one.
texts.Mailboxes:ProviderError: The mail provider could not be reached or refused the request. Try again in a moment.
texts.Mailboxes:ConnectError.consent_denied: The sign-in at the mail provider was cancelled or refused. Nothing was connected.
texts.Mailboxes:ConnectError.not_configured: This mail provider is not set up yet. The administrator enters it in Administration → Services → Integrations.
texts.Mailboxes:ConnectError.account_mismatch: You signed in with another account than the one of this mailbox. Reconnect with the mailbox's own account.
texts.Mailboxes:ConnectError.no_refresh_token: The mail provider did not grant lasting access. Connect again and accept every requested permission.
texts.Mailboxes:ConnectError.feature_disabled: Order intake is not switched on for your organisation.
texts.Mailboxes:ConnectError.provider_error: The mail provider could not complete the sign-in. Try again in a moment.
texts.Mailboxes:Error.invalid_grant: The mail provider no longer accepts the sign-in. Reconnect the mailbox.
texts.Services:Section.Ai.Description: Learns the layout of unknown order documents. Used only for tenants with AI mapping switched on.
texts.Services:Section.Google.Description: The OAuth client through which tenants connect their Gmail mailboxes (read-only).
texts.Services:Section.Microsoft.Description: The multi-tenant app registration through which tenants connect their Microsoft 365 mailboxes (read-only).
texts.Services:MailboxRedirectUri: Redirect URI to register at Google and Microsoft
texts.HealthCheck:anthropic:Impact: Unknown order documents cannot be learned; they wait in Received for attention. Known layouts keep working.
texts.HealthCheck:anthropic:Ok: Anthropic accepts the key and knows the learning model ({model}).
texts.HealthCheck:anthropic:NotConfigured: No Anthropic API key. Enter it in Administration → Services → Integrations (or set Integrations:OrderIntake:Ai:ApiKey in the deployment).
texts.HealthCheck:anthropic:Unreachable: Anthropic cannot be reached. Check the network and Anthropic's status page.
texts.HealthCheck:anthropic:Failing: Anthropic refuses the request: a wrong API key, or the model {model} does not exist. Check them in Administration → Services → Integrations.
texts.HealthCheck:google-oauth:Impact: Gmail mailboxes cannot be connected or synchronised.
texts.HealthCheck:google-oauth:NotConfigured: The Google client ID or secret is missing. Enter them in Administration → Services → Integrations.
texts.HealthCheck:google-oauth:Unreachable: Google cannot be reached. Check the network.
texts.HealthCheck:google-oauth:Failing: Google refuses the OAuth client ({error}). Check the client ID and secret.
texts.HealthCheck:microsoft-oauth:Impact: Microsoft 365 mailboxes cannot be connected or synchronised.
texts.HealthCheck:microsoft-oauth:NotConfigure: The Microsoft client ID or secret is missing. Enter them in Administration → Services → Integrations.
texts.HealthCheck:microsoft-oauth:Unreachable: Microsoft cannot be reached. Check the network.
texts.HealthCheck:microsoft-oauth:Failing: Microsoft refuses the app registration ({error}). Check the client ID and secret.
